VETERINARY TELEMEDICINE
Even from a distance, we can be close to you.
Online Consultations in Internal Medicine and Small Animal Oncology
Our clinic offers a
veterinary telemedicine
service, designed to provide
remote specialist consultations
in the field of
internal medicine
and
small animal oncology.
Thanks to telemedicine, it is possible to obtain qualified opinions and clinical support on complex cases
without the need to physically move
, optimizing diagnostic times and improving access to advanced skills. It is a valuable tool both for
veterinary professionals
who want a comparison, and for
owners
looking for a
reliable second opinion
for their animal.
Are you a homeowner looking for a second opinion?
Have you received a diagnosis and want to learn more about the therapeutic options for your pet?
Or have you been recommended a treatment plan and want to consider another point of view before starting?
Veterinary telemedicine
is the right solution for you.
By sending the documentation in your possession (reports, tests, images, videos) you will be able to directly interact with Dr. Laura Beatrice, comfortably from home.
Together you will evaluate the available options, to make more
informed and shared
decisions, respecting the well-being of your animal.
HOW IT WORKS
Fill out the dedicated form
with your details and a description of the case
Attach useful documentation
(exams, reports, videos, images)
You will be contacted to agree on
the method and time of the consultation
Consultations are conducted via video call.
For professionals, it is also possible to request a written or telephone comparison.
The service is available in Italian, English and German
, to also facilitate international owners or foreign clinics who want a specialist opinion.

Are you a veterinarian and would like to discuss a case?
We collaborate with colleagues and veterinary facilities that, despite not having specialists on site, want to offer their patients advanced support.
Dr. Laura Beatrice
, ACVIM (SAIM) graduate and active internationally, makes her experience available for:
Analysis and framing of
complex clinical cases
Review of diagnostic tests
(laboratory tests, imaging, cytological and/or histological tests)
Targeted and updated
therapeutic indications
Support in
personalized treatment planning
A fast, flexible service that can be easily integrated into daily clinical practice.
